paragraphs.text: 1. DRIVE all our enemies away, O Indra, the western, mighty Conqueror, and the eastern.
paragraphs.original: अप प्राच इन्द्र विश्वाँ अमित्रानपापाचो अभिभूते नुदस्व ।
paragraphs.translit: apa prāca indra viśvām̐ amitrānapāpāco abhibhūte nudasva |

paragraphs.text: Hero, drive off our northern foes and southern, that we in thy wide shelter may be joyful.
paragraphs.original: अपोदीचो अप शूराधराच उरौ यथा तव शर्मन्मदेम
paragraphs.translit: apodīco apa śūrādharāca urau yathā tava śarmanmadema

paragraphs.text: 2. What then? As men whose fields are full of barley reap the ripe corn removing it in order,
paragraphs.original: कुविदङ्ग यवमन्तो यवं चिद्यथा दान्त्यनुपूर्वं वियूय ।
paragraphs.translit: kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya |

paragraphs.text: So bring the food of those men, bring it hither, who went not to prepare the grass for worship.
paragraphs.original: इहेहैषां कृणुहि भोजनानि ये बर्हिषो नमोवृक्तिं न जग्मुः
paragraphs.translit: ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo namovṛktiṃ na jagmuḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Men come not with one horse at sacred seasons; thus they obtain no honour in assemblies.
paragraphs.original: नहि स्थूर्यृतुथा यातमस्ति नोत श्रवो विविदे संगमेषु ।
paragraphs.translit: nahi sthūryṛtuthā yātamasti nota śravo vivide saṃgameṣu |

paragraphs.text: Sages desiring herds of kine and horses strengthen the mighty Indra for his friendship.
paragraphs.original: गव्यन्त इन्द्रं सख्याय विप्रा अश्वायन्तो वृषणं वाजयन्तः
paragraphs.translit: gavyanta indraṃ sakhyāya viprā aśvāyanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājayantaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Ye, Asvins, Lords of Splendour, drank full draughts of grateful Soma juice,
And aided Indra in his work with Namuci of Asura birth.
5. As parents aid a son, both Asvins, Indra, aided thee with their wondrous Powers and wisdom.
When thou, with might. hadst drunk the draught that gladdens, Sarasvati, O Maghavan, refreshed thee.
paragraphs.original: यत्सुरामं व्यपिबः शचीभिः सरस्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक्
paragraphs.translit: yatsurāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak

paragraphs.text: 6. Indra is strong to save, rich in assistance may he, possessing all, be kind and gracious.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ अवोभिः सुमृळीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः ।
paragraphs.translit: indraḥ sutrāmā svavām̐ avobhiḥ sumṛḷīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ |

paragraphs.text: May he disperse our foes and give us safety, and may we be the lords of hero vigour.
paragraphs.original: बाधतां द्वेषो अभयं कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम
paragraphs.translit: bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma

paragraphs.text: 7. May we enjoy his favour, his the Holy may we enjoy his blessed loving kindness.
paragraphs.original: तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ।
paragraphs.translit: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma |

paragraphs.text: May this rich Indra, as our good Protector, drive off and keep afar all those who hate us.
paragraphs.original: स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ इन्द्रो अस्मे आराच्चिद्द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु
paragraphs.translit: sa sutrāmā svavām̐ indro asme ārācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu
